Welcome to Maha Seva Dal (Unity of People's).

Dedicated to selfless community service, healthcare, child welfare, legal empowerment, and youth development.

How can we serve together today?
Please select the Seva Wing you wish to join and dedicate your voluntary service towards:

rows.title: Community & Mahaprasad

rows.title: General Seva Cadre
rows.description: General volunteering, field assistance, event coordination

data.body:
The Legal Wing of Maha Seva Dal conducts legal literacy workshops, consumer rights assistance, and provides free legal aid to underprivileged citizens.

Would you like to enroll in this wing or return to main menu?

The Medical & Health Wing mobilizes volunteer doctors, organizes blood donation drives, free eye checkup camps, and community health awareness programs.

Would you like to enroll in this wing or return to main menu?

The Education & Child Welfare Wing distributes notebooks, uniforms, provides after-school tutoring for disadvantaged students, and youth career counseling.

Would you like to enroll in this wing or return to main menu?

The Youth & Sports Wing empowers the next generation through athletic tournaments, leadership summits, and nation-building community initiatives.

Would you like to enroll in this wing or return to main menu?

The Community Seva & Mahaprasadam Wing serves nutritious meals to pilgrims, hospital attendants, and organizes community relief during emergencies.

Would you like to enroll in this wing or return to main menu?

The General Seva Cadre is the backbone of Maha Seva Dal, participating in temple cleaning, tree plantation, elder care, and civic assistance.

data.body:
Upcoming Maha Seva Dal Programs:

1. Guru Poornima Seva Mahotsav (Mass Annadanam & Satsang)
2. Mahashivratri Seva Camp (Medical aid & pilgrim assistance)
3. State-wide Mega Blood Donation Drive

Want to participate as a volunteer coordinator?

Maha Seva Dal Foundation relies on voluntary contributions to support:

* Daily Annadanam & Hunger Relief
* Underprivileged Children School Kits
* Free Healthcare Camps & Medicines

All contributions are eligible for 80G Tax Exemption receipts.

Maha Seva Dal Foundation - Official UPI QR Code.

Scan using any UPI App (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM).
UPI ID: mahasevadal@sbi

To receive an 80G tax receipt, please reply with your Transaction ID and PAN number.

Need to discuss a local seva project, medical camp, or legal assistance in your taluk?

You can request an appointment with the Maha Seva Dal district leadership team.
